This neuron's signal is essentially the head/second element of a compound noun phrase (e.g. "fulani **herd**smen", "Hot-DIP **Gal**vanized Steel Coil", "**table** top covers", "**steel** toe work boots"), and it swings most strongly negative when such nouns appear inside repetitive SEO keyword-stuffed product/listing text (whirlpool dishwasher, cover letter, work boots), with only weak positive values on the same pattern in ordinary prose.
